Shri B.J.Chourasia - Advocate for applicant.
 Shri Pradeep Gupta - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.
 Order

This is the second bail application filed the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 562/2022 dated 23-08-2022 registered at Police Station- Kotwali Panna District Panna for commission of offence under Sections 420, 406/34 of IPC and Section 6(1)
of Madhya Pradesh Nikshepakon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000.

entities.text: Police Station- Kotwali Panna District Panna
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Madhya Pradesh Nikshepakon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He is in detention since 17-10-2023.

Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 08-02-2024 passed in M.Cr.C No. 55522/23.
2.

As per the prosecution story, the applicant along with Abhishek Yadav got registered a chit fund Company in the name of "Sarv Vibhakti Nidhi Ltd" and thereafter, by alluring the innocent investors, that they will get double of the deposited amount within a short period, got invested around Rs. 24, 50,000/- and thereafter, closed the offices and embezzled the amount.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has not committed any offence.
He has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that he is in jail for almost 2 years and 17 months and trial could not be completed.
It is also submitted that he is critically ill.

In this regard,
report received from MI Hospital, Indore and Panna jail have been referred.

sentences.text: NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12658 2 MCRC-43220-2024 4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of regular bail to the appellant.
5. Considering the detention period of the applicant and his medical condition, I deem it a fit case for grant regular bail to the applicant.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case including the detention period of the applicant, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this bail application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023/439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Dinesh Singh Yadav be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS/437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE PG Dinesh Singh Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191721044/
